note: Quality flags a family can verify, per college. A flag is only recorded when it appears in the named public source. Checked November 11, 2026: the NACEP directory lists Louisiana members (the Board of Regents as a state agency, LSU, LSU Shreveport, Bossier Parish Community College) but no Louisiana institution with an accredited concurrent enrollment program, and none of Delgado Community College, the University of New Orleans, or the University of Louisiana at Lafayette appears in the directory. So no flags are recorded yet. Southern University is working toward NACEP accreditation (self-study targeted for June 2028, per its November 2026 Task Force presentation); flags will be added college by college as public listings verify them.
